query: What rule will govern multiple encounters per patient (one index visit only vs include repeats with random effects) and how will temporally separated train/test splits prevent leakage?

response.query: What rule will govern multiple encounters per patient (one index visit only vs include repeats with random effects) and how will temporally separated train/test splits prevent leakage?
response.answer: For multiple encounters per patient, use random effects to account for repeated measures. Temporally separated train/test splits prevent leakage by ensuring future data does not influence model training. This approach maintains model integrity and validity.
